title: LIGHT SEATED INTERVALS
subtitle: THURSDAY EASY. CHAIR CIRCUIT. SHORT BREATHS.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Thursday is light seated intervals — a short, cheerful circuit in the chair. About ten minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. A light seated circuit, and you showed up. Enjoy your Thursday — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Lift one knee a little toward the ceiling, then lower with control. Alternate sides. Soft neck. A smaller lift is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts to wake the hips. Two sets of eight each leg. Soft belly, lift one knee a little, then lower with control. Soft neck. Smaller lift is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the hips. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hands at shoulder height with light weights or empty hands. Press gently upward only as far as feels kind, then lower with control. Soft neck. A smaller press is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press for light arms. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, press gently upward only as far as feels kind, then lower. Soft neck. Smaller press is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the shoulders. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Elbows bent, hands forward as if holding light weights or a band. Draw the elbows back gently and squeeze the shoulder blades together a little, then ease forward with control. Soft neck. A smaller squeeze is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row to open the upper back. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, draw the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades a little, then ease forward. Soft neck. Smaller squeeze is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the upper back. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hinge gently from the hips and reach the hands forward toward the floor or shins only as far as feels kind. Soft neck. Hold a gentle stretch, then come back up with control. A smaller reach is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach to finish soft. Two holds of about twenty seconds. Soft belly, hinge gently from the hips, reach only as far as feels kind. Soft neck. Smaller reach is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Soften the back. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Forward reach done. That's the session — lovely work.
